# Auth callback identity check client (2026-01-31 17:54Z)

_**User**_

In `@app/auth/callback/route.ts` around lines 17 - 23, The identity check is using
a new client which won't have the just-exchanged session; update the code to
reuse the existing supabase instance returned by createClient() after
exchangeCodeForSession() instead of creating a fresh one. Modify
hasEmailIdentity() to accept a Supabase client parameter (or inline the check)
and call it with the local supabase variable (the one used for
exchangeCodeForSession()), so the identity check runs in the same session
context.

        "contents": "/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has an email identity linked\n * (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n * @returns true if user has an email identity, false otherwise\n */\nexport async function hasEmailIdentity(): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (error || !user) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth)\n  // User identities include: email, google, etc.\n  // We need at least one email identity\n  const identities = user.identities || [];\n\n  // Check if any identity is an email identity (not OAuth)\n  return identities.some(\n    (identity) =&gt; identity.provider === \"email\"\n  );\n}\n\n/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has a linked profile\n * @returns true if user has a linked profile, false otherwise\n */",

        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  // Check for email identity verification first if user is authenticated\n  // This check runs for protected routes and pending-approval route\n  // Skip this check only for verify-email route and other auth routes\n  if (user &amp;&amp; !isVerifyEmailRoute &amp;&amp; (!isPublicRoute || isPendingApprovalRoute)) {\n    // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n    const { data: { user: authUser } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n    if (authUser) {\n      const identities = authUser.identities || [];\n      const hasEmailIdentity = identities.some(\n        (identity) =&gt; identity.provider === \"email\"\n      );\n\n      // If no email identity, redirect to verify email page\n      if (!hasEmailIdentity) {\n        const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n        url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-email\";\n        return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Check for linked profile if user is authenticated and not on public routes\n  // Skip this check for verify-email and pending-approval routes\n  if (user &amp;&amp; !isPublicRoute &amp;&amp; !isVerifyEmailRoute &amp;&amp; !isPendingApprovalRoute) {\n    // Get the public.users row linked to this auth user\n    const { data: publicUser } = await supabase\n      .from(\"users\")\n      .select(\"id\")\n      .eq(\"auth_user_id\", user.sub)\n      .single();\n\n    // If no publicUser or no linked profile, redirect to pending approval\n    if (!publicUser) {\n      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n      url.pathname = \"/auth/pending-approval\";\n      return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    }\n\n    // Check if there's a profile linked to this user\n    const { data: profile } = await supabase\n      .from(\"profiles\")\n      .select(\"id\")\n      .eq(\"user_id\", publicUser.id)\n      .single();\n\n    if (!profile) {\n      // User doesn't have a linked profile, redirect to pending approval\n      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n      url.pathname = \"/auth/pending-approval\";\n      return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // IMPORTANT: You *must* return the supabaseResponse object as it is.\n}",

        "contents": "│ email (google)  │   │   │ name            │\n│ ...auth fields  │   └───│ user_id (1:1)   │\n└─────────────────┘       │ work_email      │\n                          │ role (enum)     │\n                          │ removed_access  │\n                          │ removed_access_by│──┐\n                          │ created_at      │  │\n                          │ updated_at      │  │\n                          └─────────────────┘  │\n                                    ▲          │\n                                    └──────────┘ (self-reference)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Verification Logic\n\n- **Unverified**: &#96;profiles.user_id IS NULL&#96; → User logged in with Google but hasn't verified work email\n- **Pending Approval**: Work email verified via OTP, but no profile exists with that email\n- **Verified &amp; Active**: &#96;profiles.user_id IS NOT NULL AND profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **Access Revoked**: &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NOT NULL&#96;\n\n## Constants\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// lib/constants/auth.ts\nexport const ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS = [\n  'studenti.czu.cz',\n  'pef.czu.cz',\n] as const;\n\nexport const isValidWorkEmailDomain = (email: string): boolean =&gt; {\n  const domain = email.split('@')[1]?.toLowerCase();\n  return ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS.includes(domain as any);\n};\n\n// Profile roles (matches database enum)\nexport const PROFILE_ROLES = ['student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin'] as const;\nexport type ProfileRole = typeof PROFILE_ROLES[number];\n\n// Role hierarchy for permission checks\nexport const ROLE_HIERARCHY: Record&lt;ProfileRole, number&gt; = {\n  student: 0,\n  team_leader: 1,\n  coach: 2,\n  admin: 3,\n} as const;\n\nexport const hasMinimumRole = (userRole: ProfileRole, requiredRole: ProfileRole): boolean =&gt; {\n  return ROLE_HIERARCHY[userRole] &gt;= ROLE_HIERARCHY[requiredRole];\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking",

        "contents": "/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has a linked profile\n * @returns true if user has a linked profile, false otherwise\n */\nexport async function hasLinkedProfile(): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (error || !user) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Get the public.users row linked to this auth user\n  const { data: publicUser } = await supabase\n    .from(\"users\")\n    .select(\"id\")\n    .eq(\"auth_user_id\", user.id)\n    .single();\n\n  if (!publicUser) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Check if there's a profile linked to this user\n  const { data: profile } = await supabase\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .select(\"id\")\n    .eq(\"user_id\", publicUser.id)\n    .single();\n\n  return !!profile;\n}",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm() {\nconst handleSendOTP = async  {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Validate email format\n      if (!email || !email.includes(\"@\")) {\n        setError(\"Please enter a valid email address\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Validate CZU domain\n      if (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(email.trim())) {\n        setError(\"Email must end with @pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Use updateUser to add email identity to existing authenticated user\n      // This sends a verification link to the email address\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // Note: This adds the email as a secondary identity, not changing the primary email\n      const { data: updateData, error: updateError } = await supabase.auth.updateUser(\n        {\n          email: email.trim(),\n        },\n      );\n\n      if (updateError) {\n        // If email already exists, that's actually fine - it means it might already be linked\n        // or we need to handle it differently\n        if (updateError.message?.includes(\"already registered\")) {\n          setError(\"This email is already registered. Please use a different email or sign in with that email.\");\n        } else {\n          setError(updateError.message || \"Failed to send OTP code\");\n        }\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Move to OTP verification step\n      setStep(\"otp\");\n      savePersistedState({ step: \"otp\", email: email.trim() });\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"An unexpected error occurred\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Verifies the OTP code and links email identity to user\n   * Uses type 'email_change' since we're updating the user's email via updateUser()\n   * With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n   * to the existing authenticated user account\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nimport { hasEmailIdentity } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { validateRedirectUrl } from \"@/lib/utils\";\n\n/**\n * Handles OAuth callback from Google\n * Exchanges the code for a session and redirects appropriately\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams, origin } = new URL(request.url);\n  const code = searchParams.get(\"code\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n\n  if (code) {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n    const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);\n\n    if (!error) {\n      // Check if user has email identity linked\n      // If not, redirect to verify-email page\n      const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity();\n\n      // Validate the next parameter to prevent open redirects\n      const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, origin);\n      const redirectTo = validatedNext || (hasEmail ? \"/protected\" : \"/auth/verify-email\");\n\n      redirect(redirectTo);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to error page if something went wrong\n  redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=Failed to authenticate with Google&#96;);\n}",

        "contents": "-- Migration: Link users to profiles based on email matching\n-- Purpose: Automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email\n-- Affected tables: profiles, users, auth.users\n-- Special considerations: Runs automatically when user email changes in auth.users table\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger function to link profiles to users based on email matching\n-- Matches auth.users.email with profiles.work_email and links via public.users\n-- Runs with SECURITY DEFINER to access auth.users table\ncreate or replace function public.link_user_to_profile()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public, auth\nas $$\ndeclare\n  v_user_id uuid;\n  v_auth_email text;\nbegin\n  -- Get the email from auth.users (use NEW.email after update)\n  v_auth_email := new.email;\n  \n  -- Only proceed if email is not null and has changed\n  if v_auth_email is null or v_auth_email = '' then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Find the public.users row that matches this auth.users.id\n  select id into v_user_id\n  from public.users\n  where auth_user_id = new.id;\n  \n  -- If no matching public.users row found, return early\n  if v_user_id is null then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Link profile to user if work_email matches auth.users.email\n  -- Only update if profile exists and is not already linked to a different user\n  -- Normalize both sides of comparison to handle case/whitespace differences\n  update public.profiles\n  set user_id = v_user_id\n  where lower(trim(work_email)) = lower(trim(v_auth_email))\n    and (user_id is null or user_id = v_user_id);\n  \n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.link_user_to_profile() is 'Trigger function that automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email. Matches based on currently logged in user email (auth.users.email), uid in user table row (public.users.auth_user_id), and work_email in profile table row (public.profiles.work_email).';\n\n-- ============================================================================",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { hasLinkedProfile } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\n/**\n * Pending approval page\n * Shown to users who have verified their email but don't have a linked profile yet\n */\nexport default async function PendingApprovalPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to protected if already has linked profile\n  const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile();\n  if (hasProfile) {\n    redirect(\"/protected\");\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-md\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"flex flex-col gap-6\"&gt;\n          &lt;div className=\"flex flex-col gap-2\"&gt;\n            &lt;h1 className=\"text-2xl font-bold\"&gt;Pending Approval&lt;/h1&gt;\n            &lt;p className=\"text-muted-foreground\"&gt;\n              Your email address has been verified, but you need an admin to approve your account before you can access protected areas.\n            &lt;/p&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n          &lt;div className=\"rounded-lg border p-4 bg-muted/50\"&gt;\n            &lt;p className=\"text-sm\"&gt;\n              Please contact an administrator to approve your email address. Matches based on currently logged in user email (auth.users.email), uid in user table row (public.users.auth_user_id), and work_email in profile table row (public.profiles.work_email).';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TRIGGERS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger on auth.users table to link profiles when email changes\n-- Runs AFTER UPDATE to ensure email change is committed\ndrop trigger if exists link_user_to_profile_trigger on auth.users;\n\ncreate trigger link_user_to_profile_trigger\nafter update of email on auth.users\nfor each row\nwhen (old.email is distinct from new.email)\nexecute function public.link_user_to_profile();\n\ncomment on trigger link_user_to_profile_trigger on auth.users is 'Trigger that automatically links profiles to users when auth.users.email changes.         "contents": "## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]\n        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\n        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\n        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\n        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\n        G --&gt; E\n        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\n        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]\n        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\n        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\n        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\n        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\n        L --&gt; M\n        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\n        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\n        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}\n        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]\n        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email\n\n   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user\n   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nTwo tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:\n\n1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions\n2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control\n\n**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies. All business logic lives in Next.js.\n\nUse MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "## Architecture Overview",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {

          },

            "text": "        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]",

          },
          {
            "text": "        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "        G --&gt; E",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "        L --&gt; M",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "    end",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "    end",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "## Validation Flow",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "**Two-stage validation:**",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Client-side: Immediate feedback",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Checked on every request via middleware",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "Two tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies. All business logic lives in Next.js.",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "Use MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",
            "lineNumber": 96
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.17209790647029877
    },

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm() {\nconst handleSendOTP = async \n\n    }\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Verifies the OTP code and links email identity to user\n   * Uses type 'email_change' since we're updating the user's email via updateUser()\n   * With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n   * to the existing authenticated user account\n   */\n  const verifyOTP = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    const trimmedOtp = otpCode.trim();\n\n    // Track the OTP being submitted to prevent re-submission\n    setLastSubmittedOtp(trimmedOtp);\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Verify OTP code for email change/linking\n      // Use type 'email_change' because we used updateUser() to initiate the flow\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // to the current authenticated user instead of creating a new user\n      const { error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n        email: email.trim(),\n        token: trimmedOtp,\n        type: \"email_change\",\n      });\n\n      if (verifyError) {\n        setError(verifyError.message || \"Invalid OTP code\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        // Keep lastSubmittedOtp set to prevent re-submission of the same code\n        // The code remains in the input so user can see what they entered\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Refresh session to ensure identities are updated\n      await supabase.auth.refreshSession();\n\n      // Clear persisted state on success\n      clearPersistedState();\n\n      // Success - redirect to protected page\n      router.push(\"/protected\");\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"An unexpected error occurred\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n      // Keep lastSubmittedOtp set to prevent re-submission of the same code\n    }\n  }, [email, otpCode, supabase, router]);\n\n  /**\n   * Handles form submission for OTP verification\n   */\n  const handleVerifyOTP = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    await verifyOTP();\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Loads persisted state from sessionStorage after component mounts (client-side only)\n   * This prevents hydration mismatches between server and client\n   */\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./supabase/migrations/20260131120000_restrict_user_updates.sql",

        "contents": "-- Migration: Restrict user updates to suggested_work_email only\n-- Purpose: Allows users to only update suggested_work_email field, automatically updates last_otp_sent_at\n-- Affected tables: users\n-- Special considerations: Prevents users from modifying any other fields in the users table\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger function to restrict updates to suggested_work_email only\n-- Automatically updates last_otp_sent_at when suggested_work_email changes\n-- Prevents users from modifying any other fields in the users table\ncreate or replace function public.handle_user_update_restriction()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public, auth\nas $$\nbegin\n  -- Allow only suggested_work_email to be changed\n  -- Reset all other fields to their original values to prevent modification\n  new.id := old.id;\n  new.auth_user_id := old.auth_user_id;\n  new.google_email := old.google_email;\n  new.google_profile_picture := old.google_profile_picture;\n  new.google_full_name := old.google_full_name;\n  new.created_at := old.created_at;\n  \n  -- Automatically update last_otp_sent_at when suggested_work_email changes\n  if old.suggested_work_email is distinct from new.suggested_work_email then\n    new.last_otp_sent_at := now();\n  else\n    -- Keep existing last_otp_sent_at if suggested_work_email hasn't changed\n    new.last_otp_sent_at := old.last_otp_sent_at;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- updated_at is handled by the existing handle_updated_at() trigger\n  -- so we don't need to set it here\n  \n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.handle_user_update_restriction() is 'Trigger function that restricts user updates to suggested_work_email only. Automatically updates last_otp_sent_at when suggested_work_email changes. Prevents modification of all other fields including google_email, google_profile_picture, google_full_name, auth_user_id, id, and created_at.';\n\n-- ============================================================================",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "export function AuthTestPageClient() {\n\n      {user &amp;&amp; (\n        &lt;Card&gt;\n          &lt;CardHeader&gt;\n            &lt;CardTitle&gt;Test 4: Add Email Identity (CZU Domain Validation)&lt;/CardTitle&gt;\n            &lt;CardDescription&gt;\n              Test adding email identity - should only allow @pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz\n            &lt;/CardDescription&gt;\n          &lt;/CardHeader&gt;\n          &lt;CardContent&gt;\n            &lt;form onSubmit={testEmailIdentityAddition} className=\"space-y-4\"&gt;\n              &lt;div className=\"space-y-2\"&gt;\n                &lt;Label htmlFor=\"email-identity\"&gt;Email (must be CZU domain)&lt;/Label&gt;\n                &lt;Input\n                  id=\"email-identity\"\n                  name=\"email\"\n                  type=\"email\"\n                  placeholder=\"your.email@pef.czu.cz\"\n                  required\n                /&gt;\n                &lt;p className=\"text-xs text-muted-foreground\"&gt;\n                  Must end with @pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz\n                &lt;/p&gt;\n              &lt;/div&gt;\n              &lt;Button type=\"submit\"&gt;Test Email Identity Addition&lt;/Button&gt;\n            &lt;/form&gt;\n            {testResults.emailIdentity &amp;&amp; (\n              &lt;div\n                className={&#96;mt-4 p-3 rounded-md ${testResults.emailIdentity.success\n                  ? \"bg-green-100 text-green-800\"\n                  : \"bg-red-100 text-red-800\"\n                  }&#96;}\n              &gt;\n                &lt;strong&gt;Result:&lt;/strong&gt; {testResults.emailIdentity.message}\n              &lt;/div&gt;\n            )}\n          &lt;/CardContent&gt;\n        &lt;/Card&gt;\n      )}\n\n      {/* Instructions */}\n      &lt;Card&gt;\n        &lt;CardHeader&gt;\n          &lt;CardTitle&gt;Expected Results&lt;/CardTitle&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "-- Migration: Initial schema setup\n-- Purpose: Creates complete database schema with tables, triggers, and restrictive RLS policies\n-- Affected tables: users, profiles, teams\n-- Special considerations: All RLS policies are restrictive - admin operations require service_role or application-level checks\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- ENUM TYPES\n-- ============================================================================\n\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TABLES\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create users table (custom table, separate from auth.users)\n-- Stores Google OAuth user data and OTP tracking\n-- Linked to auth.users via auth_user_id for authentication checks\ncreate table public.users (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  auth_user_id uuid unique references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\n  google_email text not null unique,\n  suggested_work_email text,\n  google_profile_picture text,\n  google_full_name text,\n  last_otp_sent_at timestamptz,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\n);\n\ncomment on table public.users is 'Custom users table storing Google OAuth user data and OTP tracking.         "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { VerifyEmailForm } from \"@/components/verify-email-form\";\n\n/**\n * Email verification page\n * Users can link an email via OTP to their Google OAuth account\n * Users with existing email identities can also access this page to add additional emails\n */\nexport default async function VerifyEmailPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-sm\"&gt;\n        &lt;VerifyEmailForm /&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96; table for linked user_id\n   - Checks &#96;removed_access&#96; is null for active access\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\n\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\n\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\n\n   - Admin sets &#96;removed_access&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile\n   - Immediate effect on next request\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id')\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n}\n\n// Link profile to current user\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\nawait supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,",

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"/**\\n * Checks if the authenticated user has an email identity linked\\n * (not just OAuth providers like Google)\\n * @returns true if user has an email identity, false otherwise\\n */\\nexport async function hasEmailIdentity(): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n  const supabase = await createClient();\\n  const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\\n\\n  if (error || !user) {\\n    return false;\\n  }\\n\\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth)\\n  // User identities include: email, google, etc.\\n  // We need at least one email identity\\n  const identities = user.identities || [];\\n\\n  // Check if any identity is an email identity (not OAuth)\\n  return identities.some(\\n    (identity) =&amp;gt; identity.provider === \\\"email\\\"\\n  );\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * Checks if the authenticated user has a linked profile\\n * @returns true if user has a linked profile, false otherwise\\n */\","

                {
                  "lineNumber": 24334,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"/**\\n * Checks if the authenticated user has an email identity linked\\n * (not just OAuth providers like Google)\\n * @returns true if user has an email identity, false otherwise\\n */\\nexport async function hasEmailIdentity(): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n  const supabase = await createClient();\\n  const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\\n\\n  if (error || !user) {\\n    return false;\\n  }\\n\\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth)\\n  // User identities include: email, google, etc.\\n  // We need at least one email identity\\n  const identities = user.identities || [];\\n  \\n  // Check if any identity is an email identity (not OAuth)\\n  return identities.some(\\n    (identity) =&amp;gt; identity.provider === \\\"email\\\"\\n  );\\n}\","

                  "lineNumber": 26452,
                  "content": "However, there's a potential issue: when &#96;/protected&#96; loads, it calls &#96;hasEmailIdentity()&#96;. If that checks the profile link, ensure it reads the updated data. Checking what &#96;hasEmailIdentity()&#96; does:"
                },

If you have other code that checks &#96;profiles.user_id&#96;, it will see the updated link immediately because the trigger completes before the redirect."
                }
